years.label: Red Spring, March 1–July 15, 1919
years.atlas_dek: Red Spring: the episodes of anti-Black violence reported in the Black press from March 1 to July 15, 1919, before the Red Summer, from our dossiers, placed on 1910 county lines and by month. Built from Black weeklies only; the white press is not searched. Hover for a short summary; select a dot to read the account in the sidebar. Drafts: no entry has had human review.
